speaker: AXIOM-7
text: Altitude 1,200 meters. Wind shear 45 knots. High Command has grounded all commercial transit and initiated priority lockdown across Stratos Docks.

speaker: Mirage Blade
text: Thermal scan shows three patrol gunships on the upper pads, but the heavy VTOL transport in Bay 4 is fueled and idling. That's our ticket up the Spire.

speaker: Apex Titan
text: Mooring clamps are reinforced magnetic titan-locks. I'll need to slam the primary release valves before that bird can lift off.

speaker: Oceanus
text: The fueling lines are pressurized liquid hydrogen. One rogue spark and the whole flight deck goes up. We keep this clean.

speaker: Aura Phoenicia
text: I'm tracking air traffic control communications. The automated flight grid is scrambling drone interceptors to bottle us up on the catwalks.

speaker: Surya Prime
text: My solar barrier can deflect their anti-aircraft flak batteries along the open gantry. Stick close to my shield when we cross the flight line.

speaker: Mirage Blade
text: The security grid uses dual-phase motion lasers across the maintenance gantries. I'll phase through first and disable the local tripwires.

speaker: AXIOM-7
text: Flight path calculated. Once the VTOL is secured, we will punch directly through the Spire's mid-tier intake vents into the upper command ring.

speaker: Cyber Shogun
text: Weapons live, squad. We breach the flight deck, seize that gunship, and take this fight to the Spire. Move out!
